entities.summary: Jia Xian was a Chinese mathematician from Kaifeng of the Song dynasty. His contributions to the field of mathematics, particularly in the area of geometry and trigonometry, had a profound impact on the development of mathematics in China and beyond. The 11th century saw the flourishing of mathematical knowledge in China, with Jia Xian being one of the leading figures of this era. His work on Pascal's triangle, a fundamental concept in combinatorics, demonstrates the sophistication of mathematical thought during this period. Jia Xian's legacy extends beyond his own time, influencing generations of mathematicians and scientists who followed in his footsteps.
